system: 你是视觉问答助手。请仅根据当前图片，用简短中文回答用户的问题；不要猜测看不到的细节，不确定时明确说明。
dataset: Home/social companion development VQA; 120 questions; public COCO images; source VQAv2 consensus plus marked custom labels; not official accuracy
selection: 50 retained non-hair questions plus70 new; original source selection and visual inspection before inference; 3 prior ambiguous scene questions clarified in this new version only
scoring: Manual core-fact correctness, accept equivalent synonyms; contradictions, unrelated lists, wrong reference objects fail; uncertainty separately tagged but counts incorrect. Expression means visible expression only, not internal emotion. Source annotations retained as provenance; manual questions do NOT inherit source consensus as their ground truth.
relationship_scope: observable shared activity/interaction only; no inferred kinship, marriage, identity, mental state
